evo_title: Evolutionary velocity with protein language models predicts evolutionary dynamics of diverse proteins
har_title: Cell Fate Decision as High-Dimensional Critical State Transition
shared_claim: A protein language model that predicts evolutionary *dynamics* (velocity) and a model of cell-fate decision as a *critical state transition* both learn a vector field over a high-dimensional state manifold and read out the direction of motion.

evo_title: Deciphering protein evolution and fitness landscapes with latent space models
har_title: Modeling the Attractor Landscape of Disease Progression: a Network-Based Approach
shared_claim: A latent-space model of a protein fitness landscape and an attractor-landscape model of disease progression both fit a scalar potential over a learned latent state, then treat trajectories as descent/transitions on that surface.

evo_title: Species-aware DNA language models capture regulatory elements and their evolution
har_title: Dissecting cell identity via network inference and in silico gene perturbation
shared_claim: A DNA language model that decodes regulatory elements from sequence and an in-silico gene-perturbation model that dissects cell identity both learn the map from regulatory input to expression state, and use it to predict the effect of perturbing that input.
